zusammenfassung: Meeting in the drawing studio. Malte shows the elevations, Konrad reports: Mr Kessler wants the whole facade in glass, the requirement comes from the supervisory board. Twelve million is as good as certain, Paul takes it on.
kurz: Nordhaven wants glass, Paul takes it on “by the end of the month”.
wendung: The safe contract suddenly hinges on a glass facade.
antagonistenBezug: Nordhaven: Mr Kessler and the supervisory board’s requirement.

loseEnden.name: Glass facade “by the end of the month”
Headline: Shipyard hall on the North Quay sold
